summary: {person} watches a repair that cannot wait take the crew assigned to prepare another building for winter.
realLife: Seattle maintenance staff told auditors that urgent work crowded out the insulation work needed to keep more restrooms open through winter.
gates: A preventive job, an urgent work order and a shared trade crew.
weights: A near-term freeze raises the cost of postponing preventive work.
inGame: needs: urgent order, assigned trade crew, insulation job date and seasonal opening plan.

turns.what: The original crew stays on the insulation job.
turns.pulledBy: A second crew takes the repair.
turns.writesBack: Keep both assignments and completion dates.

turns.what: The foreperson moves the insulation date.
turns.pulledBy: The same crew must take both jobs.
